title: Student QA Engineer (Working Student)
description:
About Keyfactor 

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Student QA Engineer (Working Student)

Department: Engineering / Quality Assurance

Location: Aachen, Germany

Working Hours: Up to 19 hours per week

Employment Type: Student Employment

 

Position Overview

Keyfactor – PrimeKey Labs is seeking a Student QA Engineer to support the Engineering and Quality Assurance teams in ensuring the quality, reliability and correctness of our security and PKI-based products. The primary focus of this role is on test case design, manual test execution and product understanding, with the opportunity to explore test automation as familiarity with the systems and workflows increases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and understand product features, technical requirements and user workflows.
  • Design, document and maintain structured and traceable test cases.
  • Perform manual test execution and record results, defects and observations.
  • Collaborate with development and product teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria.
  • Identify and document test cases suitable for future automation.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGY  

We are looking for a talented Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with a drive to build quality products.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across multiple applications and throughout the entire technology stack, from databases and backend services to APIs and front-end development.

Based in Cologne, you will be a key player in the Engineering team working on the IMPECT family of applications. You’ll contribute to IMPECT’s internal services that power our data ecosystem, sourcing and managing data from external providers, ingesting and recording video content, and enabling large-scale event collection and annotation. title: Working Student Content Creation - Remote / Berlin (German Speaking)
description:

 Über Uplane Uplane will die Marketing-Industrie mit AI neu erfinden: Wir entwickeln und betreiben AI-Software, um Performance Marketing schneller, besser und effizienter zu machen. Als AI-fokussierte Marketing Agentur bieten wir Performance Marketing Management als Service an. Wir suchen nach kreativen Köpfen, die unsere Marketing Manager im Alltag bei der Kreativ-Arbeit unterstützen.

title: Laboratory Technician / Operator BTA/CTA – Protein Analytics (all genders)
description:
Role Overview Help us ensure the quality and reliability behind every protein we bring to life.
 As our Laboratory Technician - Protein Analytics, you'll be the hands-on backbone of our analytical lab, running the routine testing that tells us exactly what's happening inside our fermentation-derived proteins. From HPLC-UV runs to sample prep for proteomics and protein assays, your careful, well-documented work gives our scientists the data they need to keep pushing our precision fermentation platform forward.
Location: Frankfurt am Main
 .
 About Formo The world needs more protein than ever - not just protein that's better for the planet, but protein that performs better. We stand at the start of that shift, and we intend to lead it through precision fermentation.
 Formo is the biotech protein engine for food and nutrition, starting with enhanced casein. Casein is our first hero ingredient, and it's already winning on its own merits: better functionality than animal-based casein. Sustainable, and simply better protein. And it's only the start. We're building the engine behind it: the data, the science, the speed to keep producing the next generation of high-performance proteins.
We partner with the world's leading food and nutrition manufacturers to bring these ingredients to market at scale. From our home base in Frankfurt am Main, a team of entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators drawn from across the globe is doing the work that decides what food is made of next. Our vision? Making the cow optional. Our common thread? A passion for challenging the status quo and transforming the food and nutrition industry.
 Join us in the start of the performance era of food!
 Key Responsibilities Analytical Testing
 Perform routine HPLC-UV analyses according to established SOPs
 Conduct protein assays (e.g. Bradford) and support physicochemical analyses (e.g. particle size determination)
